note: Built from rollcall:legiscan:resolve proposals for the 2021 Regular Session, every one reviewed by hand. All proposals matched on first and last name with the seat agreeing, and none disagrees with the mapping settled for session 2251. House members the proposer could not reach were carried forward from that crosswalk where the same person appears there. Every remaining House member was checked by surname against all 105 New Mexico lower-chamber candidates in our November 2026 pool; the 15 surname collisions are all different people in different districts. Every Senate seat is null, because New Mexico senators serve four-year terms and were elected in 2024.
